strings.name: Charles Zhang
strings.summary: Charles Zhang founded Sohu’s predecessor and contributed to Chinese internet portals and digital media. He also continues to host physics livestreams. Educated in physics, he leads a business spanning media and games; company operations, investment transactions and his science communication are distinct activities.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Company founding, website launch and IPO completion, and Changyou’s privatisation and the sale of Sogou shares are distinguished. Latest loss retained; birth year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Sohu and participated in building China’s early internet portals and digital media industry, influencing online content commercialisation.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: BSc from Tsinghua University and PhD in experimental physics from MIT.
strings.facts.f2.label: Before entrepreneurship
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked as MIT’s liaison officer for China and helped establish Internet Securities Inc.’s China operations.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Portals and digital media
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led Sohu from an early website into media and games; building the platform depends on teams and partners.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Physics livestreams
strings.highlights.h2.text: Explains physics and mathematical derivations on Sohu Video; teaching science does not mean originating those theories or making new research breakthroughs.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Comments on third-quarter results
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discusses media and games in the release for the quarter ended September 30; total revenue declined year over year and the GAAP net result attributable to Sohu was a loss.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Five-year physics livestream anniversary
strings.timeline.t2.text: Discusses derivations and learning with course participants; the November 10 report covers an event held on November 8.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Launches physics lessons
strings.timeline.t3.text: Premieres his physics course on Sohu Video, explaining physical problems through formula derivations.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Sohu sells its Sogou stake
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company announces completion of the sale of all its Sogou shares to a Tencent subsidiary, leaving it with no ownership interest in Sogou.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Changyou privatisation completed
strings.timeline.t5.text: Sohu acquires all Changyou shares it did not already own, making it a wholly owned private company; Sohu itself is not delisted.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Completes initial public offering
strings.timeline.t6.text: The annual report dates predecessor Sohu.com Inc.’s IPO completion to this day, distinct from the first trading date.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Launches Sohu.com website
strings.timeline.t7.text: Relaunches the existing website under Sohu.com; the company name changes to Sohu.com Inc. in September 1999.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds Sohu’s predecessor
strings.timeline.t8.text: Internet Technologies China Incorporated is incorporated; the annual report dates his chair and CEO tenure from this month.
